widgets.label: PCC
widgets.note: DEVIATION FOUND IN SOURCE: the static HTML placeholder for #bubblePccPct/#legendPcc is 1.83 percent (= pcc/inspected = 2276/124188), but the live JS formula at source line 745 (`pccPct = d.total > 0 ? ((d.pcc / d.total) * 100).toFixed(2) : 0`) computes pcc/total = 2276/358342 = 0.64 percent, and DOMContentLoaded always calls applyFilters() on load, so the 1.83 percent placeholder is immediately overwritten and never actually shown to a user. The value above (0.64%) is the JS-computed one; the static markup's 1.83% is stale/wrong.

resetFilters.name: resetFilters
resetFilters.description: Sets filters.{subco,ha,method} back to 'All', resets the three <select> elements to 'All', and calls applyFilters(). No formula (state reset only).

getFilteredData.name: getFilteredData
getFilteredData.description: The core aggregator. Given the current `filters` (subco/ha/method), sums rawData.ha[<HA>].subco[<Subco>] (or its .methods[<Method>] sub-object when a method filter is active) across the selected HA(s) and subcontractor(s) into result.{total,constn,pcc,inspected,leaked}, plus per-subco rows (subcoList), per-HA rows with per-method detail rows (haList), and per-method inspected totals for the donut (jointMethods). Also computes overall %, leaked % and (within jointMethods) each method's share of the joint-method total.

applyFilters.name: applyFilters
applyFilters.description: Orchestrator run on load, on any filter change, and on theme/mood switch. Calls getFilteredData(), writes the summary-card / bubble text nodes from the result, relabels the HA1 section title to the selected HA (or 'HA 1' when HA filter is 'All'), then calls rebuildCharts(d).

rebuildCharts.name: rebuildCharts
rebuildCharts.description: Destroys every live Chart.js instance in `charts`, clears the registry, then re-renders all charts/tables after a 50ms setTimeout (renderAll(d)). No formula.

renderAll.name: renderAll
renderAll.description: Calls, in order: renderInspectionDonut, renderSubcoTable, renderHATable, renderHA1SubcoTable, renderHA1ProgressDonut, renderLeakedTimelineChart, renderRepairedDonut, renderMonthlyChart, renderSiteRepairChart, renderVendorRepairChart. No formula (dispatcher only).

toggleTheme.name: toggleTheme
toggleTheme.description: Flips currentTheme between 'dark'/'light', persists to localStorage, updates the sun/moon icon, and re-runs applyFilters() (so charts re-read CSS var colors). No formula.

toggleMoodDropdown.name: toggleMoodDropdown
toggleMoodDropdown.description: Toggles the .open class on the mood dropdown menu. No formula (UI only).

selectMood.name: selectMood
selectMood.description: Sets currentMood, persists to localStorage, updates the mood icon/label/active option, restarts the Christmas-garland animation if mood is 'upsidedown', and re-runs applyFilters(). No formula.

getColors.name: getColors
getColors.description: Returns palettes[currentMood].colors, the 8-color array charts pull backgroundColor/borderColor entries from by index. No formula.

startGarland.name: startGarland
startGarland.description: Every 800ms, lights a random 6-10 subset of .garland-bulb elements (cosmetic 'Upside Down' mood effect). Formula: n = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 6 (random integer in [6,10]); not data-driven.

renderInspectionDonut.name: renderInspectionDonut
renderInspectionDonut.description: Builds the 'Project Flange Inspected' doughnut from d.jointMethods (falls back to a single 'No Data' slice of value 1 when empty), sets #donutCenter to fmt(d.inspected), and rebuilds the outside legend with each slice's value and %. d.jointMethods itself is produced by getFilteredData().
formulas: d.jointMethods.length > 0 ? d.jointMethods : [{ name: 'No Data', value: 1, pct: 100 }]

renderHA1ProgressDonut.name: renderHA1ProgressDonut
renderHA1ProgressDonut.description: Picks a lookup key into rawData.ha1Progress: '<HA>_<Subco>' if both HA and subco filters are set, else '<HA>' if only HA is set, else '<Subco>' if only subco is set, else 'All'. If that key maps to null/undefined (e.g. HA2-4 with no subco filter), shows '(Blank)'. Otherwise splits total into Inspected Const / Inspected PCC / Remains (dropping any zero-value slice) and renders the donut + legend.
formulas: pct = total > 0 ? ((constn / total) * 100).toFixed(2) : 0   // Inspected Const slice
pct = total > 0 && pcc > 0 ? ((pcc / total) * 100).toFixed(2) : 0   // Inspected PCC slice
pct = total > 0 ? ((Math.max(0, remains) / total) * 100).toFixed(2) : 0   // Remains slice

renderRepairedDonut.name: renderRepairedDonut
renderRepairedDonut.description: Picks a lookup key into rawData.repair using the same '<HA>_<Subco>' > '<Subco>' > '<HA>' > 'All' precedence as the timeline/monthly charts (falls back through rawData.repair[filters.subco]/[filters.ha]/.All if the combo key is absent). Renders a 2-slice donut (Repaired vs To be Repaired) with rounded percentages, or a single grey 'No Data' slice if total is 0.

renderLeakedTimelineChart.name: renderLeakedTimelineChart
renderLeakedTimelineChart.description: Same key-lookup precedence as renderRepairedDonut but against rawData.leakedTimeline, to get a list of {date, pct} points for the line chart (min 0 / max 0.06 y-axis, tooltip shows pct to 2dp with a '%' suffix). The #leakedBadge text uses `d.leaked` from a *fresh* getFilteredData() call, not the timeline series itself.

renderMonthlyChart.name: renderMonthlyChart
renderMonthlyChart.description: Key precedence: '<HA>_<Subco>' > '<HA>_<Method>' > '<Subco>' > '<HA>' > 'All' into rawData.monthly, to get an [{month, value}] series rendered as a single bar series labelled 'Inspected'. No percentage formula (raw counts only).

renderSiteRepairChart.name: renderSiteRepairChart
renderSiteRepairChart.description: Same '<HA>_<Subco>' > '<Subco>' > '<HA>' > 'All' precedence into rawData.repair, reading .site (grouped by month, split into CCC/GAC bar series). Badge = sum of ccc+gac across all months in the selected .site array.

renderVendorRepairChart.name: renderVendorRepairChart
renderVendorRepairChart.description: Identical to renderSiteRepairChart but reads .vendor instead of .site (Flange Repair - Vendor Issue chart).

renderSubcoTable.name: renderSubcoTable
renderSubcoTable.description: Renders the 'Subcontractor Flange Status' table body from d.subcoList (the current filtered per-subco rows from getFilteredData), plus a totals row summed across subcoList.

renderHA1SubcoTable.name: renderHA1SubcoTable
renderHA1SubcoTable.description: Renders the 'HA1 Subcontractor Flange Status' table independently of getFilteredData: target HA = filters.ha, or 'HA1' when filters.ha is 'All'; for each subco in scope, reads rawData.ha[<target>].subco[<Subco>] directly (ignores the method filter entirely) and computes each row's % plus a totals row.
formulas: pct = ((sd.inspected / sd.total) * 100).toFixed(2)   // per subco row, method filter ignored

toggleHADetails.name: toggleHADetails
toggleHADetails.description: Flips expandedHAs[haName] and re-runs applyFilters() to redraw the HA table with that HA's method detail rows shown/hidden. No formula.

renderHATable.name: renderHATable
renderHATable.description: Renders the 'HA Flange Status' table body from d.haList (rows), with each row's d.details sub-array rendered as extra (initially hidden) detail rows when that HA is expanded, plus a totals row summed across haList.

fmt.name: fmt
fmt.description: Number -> locale string formatter used everywhere a count is displayed: n ? n.toLocaleString() : '0' (so 0/undefined/null all render as the string '0').

exportData.name: exportData
exportData.description: Builds one big CSV string (10 sections: subco summary, HA-by-subco breakdown, HA methods summary, HA>subco>method detail, ha1Progress, monthly, repair summary, site repair by month, vendor repair by month, leaked timeline) by iterating Object.entries() over the *entire* rawData object (all filter-key combinations, not just the current filter selection), then triggers a client-side download via a Blob + <a download>. Only formula: the subcontractor-summary totals row's leaked %.
